verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Convex has an MCP server for AI agents to interact with deployments and coding-agent integration, but there is no evidence of an AI assistant embedded IN the dashboard UI itself that lets users ask questions, get queries written, debug errors, or get backend explanations conversationally. The MCP server is a developer/agent tool accessed externally (via CLI/agent), not an in-dashboard chat assistant. missing for 10: in-dashboard AI chat/assistant UI, evidence of natural-language query generation or error debugging inside the dashboard, evidence of backend explanation features surfaced in-product.
